title: LOAD BALANCING
subtitle: Spread requests across servers, and stop sending them to the broken ones.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: GeoDNS/anycast picks the region, L4 spreads connections, L7 terminates TLS and routes by path.
Round robin for uniform work, least-outstanding for mixed costs, hashing for locality, power of two choices at scale.

items: Active: /health every few seconds, with hysteresis
Passive: eject servers whose real requests fail
Keep liveness shallow: a shared DB in every check takes all servers out at once
Rebalance long-lived WebSocket and gRPC connections
Sticky sessions for state that belongs in Redis or a token
Round robin when request costs vary 1000×

blocks.text: "GeoDNS to the nearest region, then an L7 balancer routing /api and /ws to separate pools. API servers are stateless behind least-outstanding-requests; WebSocket servers are balanced by connection count."
